title: Money Desk pick feed
description: JSON document the hourly scan publishes for the Trade Log tab. The server reads it from MONEY_DESK_FEED_URL, which defaults to the raw file data/money-desk-feed.json on branch money-desk-data. Live Kalshi fills, positions, settlements, balance, and the P&L computed from them replace the same figures in this file. Picks, skipped orders, and notes stay here. The reader ignores unknown fields and skips a row that has neither a market nor a ticker. It does not place or cancel orders.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 time the file was written.

picks_today.description: Picks for the current America/New_York day. When this array is present, including empty, the tab does not invent today's rows from the log.

pick_log.description: Full pick history, newest last or newest first. The tab sorts by timestamp.

fills.description: Optional fills that are not nested on a pick. Used only when the Kalshi fills request did not succeed. A successful Kalshi read, even an empty list, replaces every feed fill.

skipped.description: Optional skipped orders that are not nested on a pick. Merged with pick_log[].skipped.

tab.description: Desk tab or category, such as Crypto, Sports, or Weather.

market.description: Human title. A { title } object is also accepted.

ticker.description: Kalshi market ticker, copied from the API.

price.description: Entry price in dollars, 0 to 1. A whole number from 2 to 100 is read as cents.

fair_prob.description: Model probability the side wins. A number from 2 to 100 is read as a percent.

edge.description: Edge after fees, in cents. A number, or { cents_per_contract_after_fees }.

stake.description: Suggested stake in dollars, or { contracts, cost_dollars }.

notes.description: Optional note from the scan. Shown on the pick. Not a Kalshi field.

ticker.description: Inherited from the parent pick when omitted.

pnl.description: Feed P&L. Shown only when Kalshi settlements and positions were not both unavailable for a live computation. When Kalshi answers, realized is settlement payout minus cost and fees, unrealized is the open mark minus cost basis, and by_day is settlement P&L grouped by America/New_York date.

total.description: Dollars. realized + unrealized when the publisher computed both.
